title: feat(ai): AI Insights service — resale-price forecasting + RAG assistant
body:
## Summary

Adapts the AI from the [CryptoAI](https://github.com/VanshKapoor07/CryptoAI) reference (crypto price LSTM + Wikipedia RAG + GPT-2 sentiment) into Rexell's ticketing domain, and wires it into the frontend. Adds a new **`ai-insights`** FastAPI microservice (mirroring `services/detection`: `X-API-Key` auth, correlation-id logging, `/health`) plus same-origin Next.js proxy routes and UI.

Two capabilities (GPT-2 sentiment intentionally deferred to Phase 2):

- **Resale-price / demand forecasting** — CryptoAI's Binance/ccxt LSTM is retrained on Rexell's own history (`dataset/blockchain_ticketing_master.csv`, 12,005 txns) to predict the next *markup ratio* (`price_paid / original_event_price`) → a suggested resale price band in cUSD + demand trend.
- **Knowledge assistant (RAG)** — CryptoAI's LangChain/FAISS pipeline is re-pointed from Wikipedia to Rexell docs + event context, answering questions about events, tickets, resale rules and bot detection.

### Design: always-on with graceful degradation
Heavy ML libs are imported lazily so the service always boots and never fails closed:
- forecast uses the Keras LSTM when `models/resale_lstm.keras` exists, else data-driven heuristics from committed `models/event_stats.json`;
- RAG uses sentence-transformer embeddings when available else keyword retrieval; answers are LLM-synthesized when `HUGGINGFACEHUB_API_TOKEN` is set, else a concise extractive answer.

### Endpoints (`ai-insights`, port 8200)
```
GET  /health                       # no auth; reports model status
POST /v1/forecast/resale-price     # {eventId, originalPrice} -> {suggestedPrice, low, high, expectedMarkupPct, confidence, basis}
POST /v1/forecast/demand           # {eventId, horizonDays}   -> {points[], trend}
POST /v1/ask                       # {question}               -> {answer, sources[], mode}
```

### Frontend wiring
- `app/api/ai/forecast/route.ts`, `app/api/ai/assistant/route.ts` — server-side proxies that inject the API key (`AI_INSIGHTS_BASE_URL` / `AI_INSIGHTS_API_KEY`).
- `components/AI/ResalePriceSuggestion.tsx` — shown on the resell page; "Use suggested price" fills the listing input (clamped to the on-chain max-resale cap).
- `components/AI/Assistant.tsx` — global chat widget mounted in `(application)/layout.tsx`.

### Verified
- `pytest ai_insights/tests` (6 passed); `pnpm lint` + `pnpm build` clean.
- Service runs (`uvicorn`): `/health` shows `model_loaded: true`, RAG 238 chunks. Endpoints + Next.js proxies return live results; assistant widget verified in-browser (below).

![Rexell assistant widget answering a question end-to-end](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..BKoSTY8eoP4gdFRngkXq8v_mua9mTj4DvaeZ3ThXVqM)

### Notes / follow-ups
- `resale_lstm.keras` is git-ignored (regenerate with `python -m ai_insights.forecast.train`); stats/scaler JSON are committed for out-of-the-box heuristics.
- Only 851 resale rows exist — consider augmenting with `dataset/synthetic_ticketing_dataset.csv` for a stronger model.
- On-chain numeric event ids are mapped to `EVT_<nnn>`; unknown ids fall back to the global baseline.
- Rotate CryptoAI's leaked `HUGGINGFACEHUB_API_TOKEN` before reuse; this PR never uses it.
